title: Can’t Help Doing Something: Meaning, Hindi Translation, and Practice
content:
# Modal Auxiliary Verbs – 6

## Can/Could: Inability to Stop Something

### “You can’t help doing sth”

“**You can’t help doing sth**” is used to say that it is impossible to prevent or avoid something.

**Hindi meaning:** किसी कार्य को करने से रोक नहीं पाना।

### “You couldn’t help doing sth”

“**You couldn’t help doing sth**” is the past tense of “you can’t help doing sth”.

## Practice

Fill in the blanks with “**can’t help**” or “**couldn’t help**”:

1. Excuse me, I __________ overhearing what you said.
2. She is a selfish woman, but somehow I __________ liking her.
